required_state_fields.name: pm_decision_background

optional_state_fields.name: worker_execution

questions.instructions: 以当前进度，这一步该继续、拆小、直接执行还是上抛人？

labels.narrow: 收窄到剩余预算内能完成的一小块

required_state_fields.name: task_goal
required_state_fields.description: Task goal exactly as handed to the task (原文), no summary.

required_state_fields.name: reachability_facts
required_state_fields.description: What is actually known about whether this task can be completed inside its authorization/budget.

required_state_fields.name: completed
required_state_fields.description: What is actually finished so far, with evidence references; saying none is a real statement.

required_state_fields.name: remaining
required_state_fields.description: What is still unfinished for this task.

required_state_fields.name: blockers
required_state_fields.description: What blocks completion inside the boundary, or an explicit none.

required_state_fields.name: constraints
required_state_fields.description: Constraints, remaining budget and authorization that bound this judgement.

optional_state_fields.name: investigation.unknown
optional_state_fields.description: The one concrete unknown the bounded evidence step would resolve (investigate branch only).

optional_state_fields.name: investigation.evidence_source
optional_state_fields.description: A source that can actually be consulted inside the existing authorization.

optional_state_fields.name: investigation.budget
optional_state_fields.description: The real remaining budget the evidence step may use (never a reset or a new grant).

optional_state_fields.name: investigation.stop_condition
optional_state_fields.description: The concrete criterion that ends the evidence step; no open-ended investigation.

questions.instructions: 当前任务条件是否足以继续？条件不足时写出真实结论并结束本次执行；可在边界内补证时先做有界补证。

labels.terminate: 条件不足：写出完成/未完成/阻断及证据，结束本次执行（不是取消目标或 key）
labels.investigate: 继续任务并为具体未知做有界补证（须给来源、预算与结束判据）

points.description: 正式质量审核（pass/fix/reopen，附可复核依据与未覆盖面）

required_state_fields.name: review_requirements
required_state_fields.description: The quality/acceptance requirements this review is measured against.

required_state_fields.name: review_evidence
required_state_fields.description: Evidence references the review actually examined (<path>:<line> or command); [] when none.

required_state_fields.name: review_findings
required_state_fields.description: What the review found, including the concrete gap for a fix verdict.

required_state_fields.name: uncovered_scope
required_state_fields.description: What this review did not cover; an explicit none is a real statement.

optional_state_fields.name: basis_issue
optional_state_fields.description: The substantive requirement/design/acceptance problem that forces reopen; must be absent for pass.

questions.instructions: 按正式质量审核要求给出结论，并说清可复核依据、具体缺口或依据问题及未覆盖面。

labels.pass: 满足明确质量/验收要求，必要证据充分且无未解决阻断
labels.fix: 要求/依据明确，但产物或证据有具体整改缺口
labels.reopen: 要求、设计或验收依据本身有实质问题，需重新讨论确认

points.description: 具体 gate 审批（approve/steer/need_fix/reject，PM note 与理由分列）
points.p0_consequences: 自动越过 gate 会让未获授权的 stage/goal/预算/契约变更落地，且该效果不可在一次决策内撤回

required_state_fields.name: gate_background
required_state_fields.description: The concrete gate matter and why it is being sent for a decision now.

required_state_fields.name: current_state
required_state_fields.description: The current real state of the gate facts, with unknowns marked unknown.

required_state_fields.name: condition_evidence
required_state_fields.description: Evidence references for the gate conditions that are claimed to hold; [] when none.

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.subject
required_state_fields.description: The PM's pre-submission note: what exactly is being approved.

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.planned_action
required_state_fields.description: The limited action the PM would take after an approve (never implied by the choice alone).

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.basis.goal
required_state_fields.description: The goal/acceptance basis the note relies on.

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.basis.evidence
required_state_fields.description: The evidence the note relies on, with references.

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.basis.budget
required_state_fields.description: The remaining budget/limit the note relies on (no new budget is granted here).

required_state_fields.name: pm_note.basis.authority
required_state_fields.description: The existing authorization the note relies on; this note never creates one.

questions.instructions: 按 PM 送审前的 note 与当前条件判断：批准本 gate、交 PM 编排、补具体缺口，还是拒绝本次方案。

labels.approve: 满足本 gate 条件，按 note 中的受限动作继续或收尾
labels.steer: 任务组织/主线/拆分/执行主体需调整，交 PM 发起 dp-pm-steer
labels.need_fix: 推进方式基本明确但有具体技术/材料缺口，交 PM 发起 dp-auto
labels.reject: 拒绝本次推进方案；只有 note 另有明确获授权遗留方案才按其收尾

points.description: 任意 key 收尾的签收结论（四部材料 + 三数组，按 key 计算）

required_state_fields.name: delivery_goal
required_state_fields.description: Delivery goal including the user's acceptance conditions.

required_state_fields.name: actual_completion
required_state_fields.description: What was actually completed against the delivery goal.

required_state_fields.name: verification_evidence.verified
required_state_fields.description: Verification evidence that was actually verified; [] when there is none.

required_state_fields.name: verification_evidence.unverified
required_state_fields.description: Evidence that is not verified (or was not run); [] means a verified none, never a missing fact.

required_state_fields.name: unfinished_impact
required_state_fields.description: Unfinished items and their impact; [] means nothing is unfinished, never a missing fact.

questions.instructions: 按交付目标、实际完成与验证证据判断：这次交付可以收尾，还是需要继续完成，或交用户确认？不以任务数量或完成声明代替证据。

labels.finalize: 可以收尾：按交付目标与验收条件直接签收
labels.continue: 继续完成：交 PM 推进未完成的缺口
labels.user-confirm: 交用户确认：由 PM 提出具体待确认项

points.description: PM 现场动态行动选择（候选由 PM 准备，仅从候选集合选择）

required_state_fields.name: question
required_state_fields.description: The pending question verbatim (what exactly needs a decision), written before any answer.

required_state_fields.name: background.task_goal
required_state_fields.description: Task goal the question is asked against.

required_state_fields.name: background.current_state
required_state_fields.description: What is actually known so far; unknowns are marked unknown, never invented.

required_state_fields.name: background.tried
required_state_fields.description: What has already been tried for this live problem, factually.

required_state_fields.name: background.unknowns
required_state_fields.description: The facts still unknown; never filled in by inference.

required_state_fields.name: background.constraints
required_state_fields.description: The authorization/budget/role constraints that bound every candidate.

required_state_fields.name: handling_options
required_state_fields.description: PM-prepared, problem-specific action candidates [{id,label,description,consequence,risk,conditions}]; ids only need to be unique in this request (no legacy cN/2..5 bound).

questions.instructions: 从 PM 已准备的候选处理方式中选出最合适的一项；不得提出未准备的方案，也不得以失败原因或概率代替依据。

required_state_fields.name: decision_actor
required_state_fields.description: The real business subject whose decision is needed (not a self-reported role claim).

required_state_fields.name: decision_object
required_state_fields.description: The concrete object/artefact the pending question is about.

required_state_fields.name: question
required_state_fields.description: The pending question verbatim (what exactly needs a decision), written before any answer.
